chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
The person afflicted with an overpowering stomach condition performs wudu (ablution) and continues on his salat (prayer).

key_terms.الْبَطَنِ: the stomach or abdominal condition being referred to
key_terms.الْغَالِبِ: overpowering or prevailing, indicating a recurring and difficult condition
key_terms.يَبْنِي: he continues and builds upon what has already been performed

ai.seo_question: What should a person with an overpowering stomach condition do if it affects their wudu (ablution) during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one overcome by a recurring stomach condition during salat (prayer). It indicates that such a person should renew wudu (ablution) and then continue building upon the prayer already begun.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1043 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:
"The person who has a frequent (or overpowering) stomach condition should perform ablution (wudu) and continue with their prayer (salat)."
